frozen_candidate_root_contribution: بَغْتَةً marks the onset/arrival of a decreed, dreaded event (the Hour ٱلسَّاعَة, the punishment ٱلْعَذَاب, or God's seizing أخذ) in a manner experienced by its recipients as unperceived and unprepared-for — arriving unheralded *to them*, Quran-internally opposed to جَهْرَةً (open/manifest arrival, 6:47). The distinctive axis is perceptibility-of-onset to the victim (hidden vs. open), not lexicalized velocity; the destructive/eschatological content is carried by the subject-nouns, not by بغت. The entire root footprint is this one frozen accusative adverb.

internal_discovery.candidate_root_contribution: بَغْتَةً marks the onset/arrival of a decreed, dreaded event (the Hour ٱلسَّاعَة, the punishment ٱلْعَذَاب, or God's seizing أخذ) in a manner experienced by its recipients as unperceived and unprepared-for — arriving unheralded *to them*, Quran-internally opposed to جَهْرَةً (open/manifest arrival, 6:47). The distinctive axis is perceptibility-of-onset to the victim (hidden vs. open), not lexicalized velocity; the destructive/eschatological content is carried by the subject-nouns, not by بغت. The entire root footprint is this one frozen accusative adverb.
internal_discovery.plain_explanation: Every one of the 13 occurrences is the identical word بَغْتَةً — an accusative adverb ('baghtatan') attached to a verb of coming (تأتي/يأتي/جاء/أتى) or of God's seizing (أخذنٰهم). There is no verb, participle, or other noun form of this root anywhere in the corpus, so we can only certify the behavior of one lexicalized adverb, not a root paradigm. The word says the Hour or the punishment reaches people while they do not perceive it and cannot prepare or repel it: six verses gloss it directly with وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ / وَأَنتُمْ لَا تَشْعُرُونَ, 21:40 says it dumbfounds them (فَتَبْهَتُهُمْ) so they cannot repel it, and 6:47 sets it explicitly against جَهْرَةً ('openly'), showing the contrast is about being unperceived, not about being fast. It never modifies a neutral or welcome arrival.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: بغت does NOT lexicalize: (1) the harm/seizure itself — that is carried by أخذ/عذاب/الساعة (6:44, 6:47); (2) mere speed/velocity — the attested antonym is جَهْرَةً 'openly' (6:47), not 'slowly'; (3) 'absence of all prior signs' — 47:18 has أشراطها (portents) already present yet the arrival is still بَغْتَةً, so it means unapprehended-at-onset, not objectively unforeseeable; (4) unpremeditation by the doer — 6:44 shows a deliberate divine set-up (فَتَحْنَا... حَتَّىٰ إِذَا فَرِحُوا... أَخَذْنَٰهُم بَغْتَةً), so بغتة is unexpected-to-the-victim, never rash-by-the-agent; (5) demonstrably 'ominous' as an intrinsic feature — 0/13 attach to a neutral or positive event, so the corpus cannot isolate whether dread is part of the word or only its fixed company (honest UNRESOLVED valence boundary).
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: 47:18:7:1 «أَن تَأْتِيَهُم بَغْتَةً فَقَدْ جَآءَ أَشْرَاطُهَا» — its portents have already come, yet the arrival is still بَغْتَةً. This defeats any maximal 'no warning / utterly unforeseeable' reading and disciplines the claim down to the narrow recipient-non-perception sense: signs may be present ambiently, but the actual onset still catches them unapprehended and unprepared. It refines the nucleus rather than breaking it.
internal_discovery.strongest_competitor: A pure temporal/manner reading: بَغْتَةً = 'all-at-once / abruptly (fast),' treating لَا يَشْعُرُونَ as an independent ḥāl that adds non-perception rather than constituting the meaning. It rides on the same 6:47 datum (reading جَهْرَةً as 'gradually/progressively visible') and gains support from 21:40's فَتَبْهَتُهُمْ (overwhelming shock). It is weaker because the antonym of a speed term would be 'slow,' whereas جَهْرَة sits on the manifestness axis, and 47:18 ties the sense to apprehension not objective rate — but it cannot be eliminated Quran-internally, which is one reason the grade is capped below STRONG.

It rides on the same 6:47 datum (reading جَهْرَةً as 'gradually/progressively visible') and gains support from 21:40's فَتَبْهَتُهُمْ (overwhelming shock). It is weaker because the antonym of a speed term would be 'slow,' whereas جَهْرَة sits on the manifestness axis, and 47:18 ties the sense to apprehension not objective rate — but it cannot be eliminated Quran-internally, which is one reason the grade is capped below STRONG.
internal_discovery.rationale: All three analysts converge that the meaning of the lexeme بَغْتَةً is exceptionally well established internally (explicit antonym جهرة at 6:47; restrictive gloss لا تأتيكم إلا بغتة tied to hidden timing at 7:187; six co-textual paraphrases لا يشعرون) and that no occurrence resists the narrow account. On word-level criteria this approaches STRONG (Analyst B holds STRONG). However the contract's over-grading guard is decisive: 100% of the evidence is a single frozen, lexicalized accusative adverb with zero morphological/derivational spread against which to triangulate a *root-level* nucleus. 'Broad distinctive' evidence for STRONG means breadth across a paradigm; 13 tokens of one indeclinable adverb are depth on a single point. Per the rule that a lexicalized/nominal class caps strength at MODERATE and scope at REPRESENTATIVE — applied a fortiori when the lexicalized nominal is the *entire* footprint — plus an un-eliminated manner-vs-epistemic competitor and the 47:18 boundary, the honest grade is MODERATE / REPRESENTATIVE / LEXICALIZED_CLASS. RESISTANT/UNRESOLVED would be dishonest: there is no genuine internal resistance to the narrow account, only a ceiling on generalization.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: بَغْتَةً as the manner of God's transitive seizing (أَخَذْنَٰهُم): the complacent (فَرِحُوا 6:44; عَفَوا 7:95) are seized while unaware (7:95: وهم لا يشعرون). The recipient-unawareness core holds even though the syntax shifts from intransitive arrival to transitive strike.
clusters.classification_rationale: Structurally atypical sub-pattern (agent = Allah, verb أخذ) but semantically continuous; shows the 'arrival' framing of C1–C3 is contextual, not part of the root.
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: 6:44 shows the seizure is premeditated (فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ أَبْوَٰبَ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ حَتَّىٰ إِذَا فَرِحُوا... أَخَذْنَٰهُم بَغْتَةً), fixing بغتة as unexpected-to-the-victim, not unpremeditated-by-the-doer.

reconciliation.rationale: General signs are not perception of the actual onset; the moment still catches them unprepared. The verse refines the nucleus to narrow recipient-non-perception rather than breaking it — an adversarial boundary, not a resistant seam.
The recipient-oriented core (they are unprepared; God plans) holds identically; the arrival framing is shown to be contextual. Structural atypicality, not semantic fracture.

adversarial_verification.notes: The adversarial lens (C) sought perceived-in-advance onsets and a velocity-axis antonym and found neither: the sole internal antonym is جَهْرَةً (perceptibility axis, 6:47), the restrictive 7:187 glosses suddenness by hidden timing, and 47:18's portents do not equal perception of onset. No occurrence fails the narrow recipient-non-perception account, so failing_occurrences=[]. Distinctiveness is anchored by an actual Quranic antonym plus repeated لا يشعرون self-gloss. The un-eliminated manner/speed competitor and the single-frozen-lexeme footprint cap the *strength* at MODERATE but do not constitute a falsifying occurrence.

independent_verification: Three independent analysts (A, B, C) each read all 13 tokens; all affirm the narrow account fits every occurrence with no resistant sub-class, converging on the perceptibility-of-onset distinctive (B at STRONG, A and C at MODERATE).
candidate_root_contribution: بَغْتَةً marks the onset/arrival of a decreed, dreaded event (the Hour ٱلسَّاعَة, the punishment ٱلْعَذَاب, or God's seizing أخذ) in a manner experienced by its recipients as unperceived and unprepared-for — arriving unheralded *to them*, Quran-internally opposed to جَهْرَةً (open/manifest arrival, 6:47). The distinctive axis is perceptibility-of-onset to the victim (hidden vs. open), not lexicalized velocity; the destructive/eschatological content is carried by the subject-nouns, not by بغت. The entire root footprint is this one frozen accusative adverb.

layer_attribution.occurrence_evidence: 13/13 tokens are the identical accusative adverb بَغْتَةً (bagotapF; qac_pos=N, form=N, qac_verb_form=null) on verbs of arrival (تأتي/يأتي/جاء/أتى, 11×) or divine seizure (أخذنٰهم, 2×); six carry لا يشعرون/لا تشعرون.
layer_attribution.derivation: No derivational spread whatsoever — no verb, participle, or alternate nominal pattern; the root surfaces only as one frozen maṣdar-adverb, so no productive paradigm exists to triangulate.
layer_attribution.lexical_class: A single lexicalized accusative adverbial (ḥāl / maf'ūl muṭlaq); the claim is about this lexeme/nucleus (LEXICALIZED_CLASS) and does not extend to any non-existent derivational family, hence REPRESENTATIVE scope and the MODERATE cap.
layer_attribution.contextual_relation: The eschatological/punitive dread and the destruction are supplied contextually by the subject-nouns (ٱلسَّاعَة, ٱلْعَذَاب) and the seizing verb أخذ, plus consequence clauses (فتبهتهم, مبلسون, يٰحسرتنا); these are narrative/contextual and must NOT be read into بغت itself, which contributes only manner-of-onset.
layer_attribution.reconciliation: Preliminary resistance at 47:18 (ambient portents) and structural doubt at 6:44/7:95 (transitive seizure) both reconcile to CONSISTENT: signs ≠ perception of onset, and recipient-unawareness holds across the syntactic shift; tensions are adversarial boundaries / structural atypicalities, not resistant seams.
layer_attribution.unresolved_resistance: No occurrence resists the narrow account; residual unresolved items are (a) the manner/speed competitor un-eliminable Quran-internally at 21:40/6:47, and (b) valence-neutrality (0/13 neutral referents), both flagged as honest limits rather than refutations.

hard_case_representation.rationale: There is no genuine resistant sub-class — the narrow account fits all 13. But four occurrences carry real adversarial/structural weight worth recording: 47:18 (ambient portents), 21:40 (overwhelm/speed competitor), and 6:44/7:95 (transitive-seizure atypicality). Each is documented with an evidence_basis whose statement also appears as the strongest_counterexample or in the corresponding cluster/override note.

rejection_condition.challenging_finding: A Quran-internal occurrence of بَغْتَةً (or any newly attested ب-غ-ت derivation) in which the recipients demonstrably perceive/apprehend the actual onset in advance, or in which the antonym pairing places بغتة on a velocity axis (بغتة vs. a 'slow/gradual' term) rather than the manifestness axis of جَهْرَةً.
rejection_condition.search_location: The 13 attested tokens, especially 6:47 (بغتة/جهرة disjunction), 7:187 (restrictive), 47:18 (portents), 21:40 (فتبهتهم); plus any future non-eschatological or non-punitive referent.
rejection_condition.verification_method: Re-read each verse's subject, verb, and adjacent ḥāl clauses (لا يشعرون / لا تشعرون); test whether an occurrence requires perceived-in-advance onset or a speed antonym incompatible with perceptibility-of-onset.
rejection_condition.confounder_control: Do not import dictionary/tafsir 'suddenly=fast' priors; hold the destructive valence to the subject-nouns (الساعة/العذاب/أخذ), not to بغت; distinguish ambient signs (أشراطها) from perception of the actual onset.
rejection_condition.failure_consequence: If perceived-in-advance onset or a velocity-axis antonym is confirmed, the perceptibility-of-onset distinctive is falsified and the claim collapses to bare 'suddenly,' downgrading result_strength and possibly moving to UNRESOLVED on the distinctive.

reopen_conditions: If any verbal, participial, or alternate nominal derivation of ب-غ-ت surfaces beyond the frozen accusative بَغْتَةً, re-triangulate a genuine root-level nucleus and lift the LEXICALIZED_CLASS / REPRESENTATIVE cap.

If بَغْتَةً is ever attested with a neutral or welcome referent (currently 13/13 attach to ٱلسَّاعَة / ٱلْعَذَاب / أخذ), revisit the UNRESOLVED valence boundary and test whether 'ominous' is intrinsic or merely fixed company.

If a Quran-internal contrast is found that anchors a velocity/all-at-once reading (بغتة vs. a 'gradual' term) independent of the جَهْرَةً manifestness axis at 6:47, re-adjudicate the manner-vs-epistemic competitor exposed at 21:40.

falsification_evidence.status_rationale: The adversarial lens (C) sought perceived-in-advance onsets and a velocity-axis antonym and found neither: the sole internal antonym is جَهْرَةً (perceptibility axis, 6:47), the restrictive 7:187 glosses suddenness by hidden timing, and 47:18's portents do not equal perception of onset. No occurrence fails the narrow recipient-non-perception account, so failing_occurrences=[]. Distinctiveness is anchored by an actual Quranic antonym plus repeated لا يشعرون self-gloss.
